I played this game as soon as it launched and by god, is it GOOD.

The graphics are genuinely amazing. The models are detailed (though the monkeys lack ears for some reason), the lighting and pseudo raytracing is GORGEOUS, the environments are very well designed (except the water lol) and the destruction system is surprisingly well-done.

The controls feel very good and the physics are surprisingly good.
HOWEVER, they really should add support for left handed players (which would swap the controls to opposite hands) and maybe have customisable button mapping as well for some extra accessibility.

Lastly, the gameplay itself. The weapons feel like BUTTER to handle, the grappling gun is fun to play with and sniping players from halfway across the map is SUCH a dopamine rush. Asides from 90% of the playerbase being sweats, it's good fun.

Who knows, maybe within the next few updates I might have to bump this review to a 5-star!
